title: Understanding BMI Calculation
text: The BMI is calculated using the formula: weight in kg divided by the square of height in meters. Make sure you convert the height from centimeters to meters before squaring it.

title: Effect of Noise on Data
text: Adding noise to the height and weight columns will affect their values, but the BMI column remains unchanged. Consider how this might impact the models and their parameters.
